# Resolved install set for the sidecar test run: requirements.lock.txt plus
# pytest and what pytest pulls in.
#
# Compiled from requirements-dev.txt for the same reason its runtime companion
# exists -- floors resolve differently on two machines -- and compiled
# separately rather than assumed to be the runtime lock with pytest appended,
# because adding a package can move the resolution of the packages already
# there. CI installs this file.
#
# Compiled --universal, so this one file serves Linux CI and macOS or Windows
# development: the entries that differ by platform carry environment markers
# and pip skips the ones that do not apply. Hashes are included, which makes
# pip refuse any artifact that does not match.
#
# Regenerate with:
#
#   uv pip compile --universal --python-version 3.12 --generate-hashes \
#     --no-header requirements-dev.txt -o requirements-dev.lock.txt
#
# then restore this header, which the command does not write.
